name: Raising The Dead
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign power over death, as demonstrated in Ezekiel's vision where the LORD brings life to dry bones, symbolizing the resurrection of His people from death and captivity. Jesus' ministry further confirms this authority, commanding His followers to raise the dead as a sign of the kingdom of heaven's arrival. The resurrection power is also evident at Christ's own death, when many saints were raised from their graves, affirming God's ultimate victory over death. Even in moments of human despair, such as the death of the synagogue ruler's daughter, Jesus' power to restore life remains unshaken.
